name: Vitamin D3
description: Vitamin D contributes to normal calcium absorption, bone maintenance and immune function.
ingredient_form: Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol). Final carrier and finished-product grade are to be confirmed.
ingredient_source: The reference catalog describes an algae-derived vegan D3. This is a reference ingredient source, not a confirmed VITA TAPE supplier.
ingredient_functions: Helps the body absorb calcium and maintain normal bones and teeth. | Contributes to normal muscle and immune function.
evidence_notes: These are established nutrient roles. Extra vitamin D is not a guaranteed immunity boost when intake is already adequate.
ingredient_considerations: Review total vitamin D across all supplements; a reference catalog amount is not a personal daily target.

name: Vitamin C
description: An essential vitamin involved in normal collagen formation and antioxidant protection.
ingredient_form: Vitamin C; the exact ascorbic acid / ascorbate grade has not been specified for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_source: Citrus fruit, peppers and other produce are food sources. The orange illustration does not mean this ingredient is extracted from oranges.
ingredient_functions: Contributes to normal collagen formation for skin, cartilage and blood vessels. | Helps protect cells from oxidative stress and supports absorption of non-haem iron.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles; an antioxidant role does not demonstrate prevention or treatment of disease.
ingredient_considerations: Larger supplemental amounts can cause digestive discomfort. The final raw material and total daily amount need confirmation.

name: Vitamin B12
description: The reference uses cyanocobalamin, a form of vitamin B12 involved in energy metabolism and nervous system function.
ingredient_form: Cyanocobalamin is the form named in the reference catalog; the final VITA TAPE form is not yet selected.
ingredient_source: B12 is made by microorganisms and commercial ingredients can be produced by fermentation. Animal foods and fortified foods are dietary sources; this is not a fruit-derived vitamin.
ingredient_functions: Supports normal red blood cell formation and nervous system function. | Contributes to energy metabolism; correcting a deficiency differs from stimulating energy.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. Extra B12 has not been shown to improve energy in people with adequate B12 status.
ingredient_considerations: Dietary intake and absorption both affect B12 status; this card cannot assess a deficiency.

name: Magnesium
description: Magnesium contributes to normal muscle and nervous system function. This builder explores ingredients; it does not assess a deficiency or prescribe an intake.
ingredient_form: Magnesium. No citrate, glycinate, oxide or other salt / chelate has been selected for this concept.
ingredient_source: Nuts, seeds, legumes and leafy greens are food sources. The mineral illustration is not an edible raw material or a specified supplement form.
ingredient_functions: Contributes to normal muscle and nervous system function. | Supports normal energy metabolism and electrolyte balance.
evidence_notes: Established mineral roles. Evidence for sleep benefits depends on the population, magnesium status and preparation.
ingredient_considerations: Supplemental magnesium can interact with some medicines. People with impaired kidney function need individual advice.

name: Omega 3
description: Omega 3 describes a family of fatty acids. Effects and suitability depend on the type and amount. Final source, allergens and quantities will be confirmed on the product label.
ingredient_form: Omega-3 fatty acids. EPA, DHA and ALA composition, oil form and protective carrier have not yet been specified.
ingredient_source: Fish oil and microalgae can supply EPA / DHA; flax, chia and other plant foods supply ALA. No fish- or algae-based source has been confirmed for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_functions: Omega-3 fats contribute to cell membrane structure. | EPA and DHA are studied for cardiovascular and other outcomes; benefits depend on type and amount.
evidence_notes: The fatty acid composition matters. Results for an EPA / DHA product cannot be assumed for an unspecified omega-3 blend.
ingredient_considerations: Final sourcing determines fish allergens and vegan suitability. Oil weight is not the same as EPA plus DHA content.

name: Zinc
description: An essential mineral involved in normal immune function and maintenance of skin, hair and nails.
ingredient_form: Zinc; citrate appears on a reference finished-product label. The VITA TAPE salt or chelate is not confirmed.
ingredient_source: A purified zinc ingredient is used in supplements. Meat, shellfish, beans and nuts are food sources; the metallic specimen is only an illustration.
ingredient_functions: Contributes to normal immune function. | Helps maintain normal skin, hair and nails and supports DNA and protein synthesis.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. Supplementing beyond need is not the same as improving immunity.
ingredient_considerations: Long-term high zinc intake can affect copper status and some medicines need spacing from zinc supplements.

name: Collagen
description: A structural protein ingredient shown in the supplied VITA TAPE design. Source, amount and suitability remain to be confirmed.
ingredient_form: Collagen concept; peptide type, degree of hydrolysis and molecular weight have not been specified.
ingredient_source: Commercial collagen commonly comes from fish, bovine or porcine tissue. Species, tissue source, allergens and any alternative technology remain unconfirmed for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_functions: Supplies amino acids and peptides rather than replacing collagen directly in skin. | Specific oral peptide preparations have been studied for skin hydration and joint-related outcomes.
evidence_notes: Human findings are preparation-dependent and mixed. A small concept amount cannot be assumed to reproduce a clinical study.
ingredient_considerations: Source and processing determine allergens and dietary suitability. This concept has no confirmed vegan claim.

name: Probiotics
description: A live bacterial ingredient in the reference catalog. Probiotic effects depend on strain, quantity and individual context.
ingredient_form: The reference is LactoSpore®, the spore-forming strain Heyndrickxia coagulans MTCC 5856, formerly Bacillus coagulans.
ingredient_source: Produced by controlled microbial fermentation, not by adding yogurt or generic mixed bacteria. VITA TAPE has not confirmed procurement or processing survival.
ingredient_functions: Specific strains have been studied for digestive comfort and bowel-related outcomes. | Spore formation is a formulation characteristic; it does not guarantee a benefit in every product.
evidence_notes: Evidence is strain-specific. Finished-product viability and stability need verification before making product claims.
ingredient_considerations: People who are seriously ill or immunocompromised should seek advice before using live probiotic products.

name: L-Theanine
description: L-theanine is an amino acid found in tea. This ingredient is shown for exploration; final source, amount and suitability are pending product review.
ingredient_form: L-theanine; purity and whether the material is extracted, fermented or otherwise manufactured are not yet selected.
ingredient_source: Camellia sinensis tea leaves are a natural source. The tea image indicates that association, not a confirmed tea extraction process.
ingredient_functions: Studied for relaxation and stress-related responses. | Attention studies often examine L-theanine with caffeine; those results do not establish the effect of this concept alone.
evidence_notes: Small human studies suggest some effects, but evidence is limited and a final product benefit is not established.
ingredient_considerations: Theanine content, caffeine content and extract identity are separate specifications.

name: Ashwagandha
description: A traditional root extract, explored in the reference catalog for calm, sleep and everyday resilience.
ingredient_form: Ashwagandha extract. Root-only versus root-and-leaf material, extraction ratio and withanolide standardisation remain unspecified.
ingredient_source: Withania somnifera plant material. The root illustration does not establish a root-only supply specification.
ingredient_functions: Some preparations have been studied for perceived stress. | Some small trials have examined sleep-related outcomes.
evidence_notes: Results vary by preparation and study quality; they do not establish treatment of anxiety or insomnia.
ingredient_considerations: Avoid during pregnancy. Liver, thyroid and medicine-related precautions require review before use.

name: Iron
description: An essential mineral used in normal haemoglobin formation. Individual suitability should be assessed before supplementing.
ingredient_form: Iron; the specific ferrous / ferric salt or chelate has not been confirmed for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_source: Purified iron compounds are used in supplements. Meat, seafood, legumes and fortified foods are dietary sources; the metal image is conceptual.
ingredient_functions: Supports normal red blood cell formation and oxygen transport. | Contributes to normal energy metabolism and cognitive function.
evidence_notes: Established mineral roles. Fatigue does not by itself establish iron deficiency or a need for iron.
ingredient_considerations: Unnecessary iron can be harmful. Iron supplements must be kept out of reach of children.

name: HydroCurc™ & Black Pepper Extract
description: A curcumin and black pepper extract combination, explored for antioxidant and joint support.
ingredient_form: HydroCurc® is a cold-water-dispersible Curcuma longa extract using LipiSperse®. Black pepper extract is listed separately in this catalog entry.
ingredient_source: Turmeric rhizome supplies curcuminoids; Piper nigrum supplies the separate pepper ingredient. HydroCurc itself does not contain piperine.
ingredient_functions: Curcuminoids are researched for joint comfort and other outcomes. | Dispersion technology changes ingredient delivery; it is not itself evidence of a health outcome.
evidence_notes: Research depends on the curcumin preparation. Supplier absorption studies do not validate the final VITA TAPE formula.
ingredient_considerations: Pepper extract and concentrated curcumin can affect medicine use; the final combination requires review.

name: 5-HTP
description: 5-HTP is a serotonin precursor. The reference catalog groups it with mind and sleep ingredients.
ingredient_form: 5-HTP ingredient. Extract purity and its final raw-material specification are not yet selected.
ingredient_source: Griffonia simplicifolia seeds are a major commercial source. Final extraction method, supplier and origin have not been confirmed.
ingredient_functions: Acts as a biochemical precursor in serotonin synthesis. | Has been investigated for mood and sleep; that research does not establish this concept as a treatment.
evidence_notes: Clinical evidence is limited. A biochemical mechanism is not proof of benefit at the reference catalog amount.
ingredient_considerations: Do not combine with serotonergic medicines without professional advice because of serotonin syndrome risk.

name: Apple Cider Vinegar
description: An apple-derived vinegar ingredient, listed in the reference catalog for metabolic wellness.
ingredient_form: Apple cider vinegar ingredient; the catalog does not specify drying method, carrier or acetic acid percentage.
ingredient_source: Apple sugars are fermented to alcohol and then vinegar. The illustrated liquid bottle does not establish the form used in a tape.
ingredient_functions: Provides fermentation-derived organic acids when retained in the preparation. | Vinegar has been researched for meal-related metabolic responses.
evidence_notes: Evidence for liquid vinegar cannot be transferred directly to an unspecified dried ingredient or this reference amount.
ingredient_considerations: No weight-loss or blood-sugar treatment claim is established for this formula.

name: Beetroot
description: A beetroot-derived botanical, explored for physical performance and recovery.
ingredient_form: Beetroot ingredient. Powder versus extract and nitrate standardisation are not specified in the current catalog record.
ingredient_source: Beta vulgaris root. Variety, growing conditions and processing can change the nitrate content.
ingredient_functions: Dietary nitrate can participate in nitric oxide pathways. | Standardised beetroot juice preparations have been studied for exercise economy and endurance.
evidence_notes: Powder weight does not establish nitrate exposure. Juice-study results do not prove an effect from this tape concept.
ingredient_considerations: The amount of nitrate, not just the total beetroot ingredient mass, matters when comparing research.

name: Beta Glucan
description: A polysaccharide ingredient listed in the reference catalog under immune support.
ingredient_form: Beta-glucan ingredient. Linkage pattern, purity and exact source are not specified for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_source: Yeast, fungi, oats and barley contain different beta-glucans. The reference discusses yeast beta-glucan; the yeast image does not confirm a supplier.
ingredient_functions: Yeast beta-glucans have been studied for immune-related responses. | Oat and barley beta-glucans are different soluble fibres with different research and amounts.
evidence_notes: Evidence is source- and structure-specific. Do not transfer an oat fibre claim to an unspecified yeast preparation.
ingredient_considerations: Final source, beta-glucan percentage and any cereal allergen status need confirmation.

name: BPL1®
description: A heat-treated B. lactis CECT8145 postbiotic ingredient. BPL1 is a third-party trademark.
ingredient_form: Heat-treated Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis CECT 8145, known as HT-BPL1™.
ingredient_source: A controlled bacterial culture followed by heat treatment. ADM identifies both live BPL1 and the separate heat-treated format; this record uses the latter.
ingredient_functions: Researched for metabolic-health and body-composition-related outcomes. | A heat-treated format has different formulation needs from a live microbial ingredient.
evidence_notes: Research is specific to the strain and format. It does not establish weight loss or efficacy of this final formula.
ingredient_considerations: Live BPL1, heat-treated BPL1 and generic bifidobacteria are not interchangeable descriptions.

name: Careflow™ Mango Powder
description: A branded mango fruit powder, explored for circulation and physical performance.
ingredient_form: Careflow™ mango fruit powder; it is not a mango flavour or automatically a mangiferin-standardised extract.
ingredient_source: Mangifera indica fruit. Final grade, supplier agreement and country of manufacture are not confirmed for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_functions: Ingredient studies have investigated microcirculation. | Other exploratory work has examined metabolic and physical-performance outcomes.
evidence_notes: Early ingredient-specific research; this is not proof of a cardiovascular or performance effect from the final tape.
ingredient_considerations: A branded ingredient reference does not establish VITA TAPE supply or trademark authorisation.

name: CoQ10
description: A naturally occurring coenzyme explored for cellular energy and cardiovascular wellness.
ingredient_form: CoQ10; ubiquinone versus ubiquinol, particle size and carrier have not been specified.
ingredient_source: The body makes CoQ10, and foods contain small quantities. The commercial production route for VITA TAPE has not been chosen.
ingredient_functions: Participates in cellular energy production. | Has antioxidant activity; that mechanism does not establish a clinical benefit.
evidence_notes: Human results vary by condition and preparation. A normal biological role is not evidence of an energy boost in healthy users.
ingredient_considerations: CoQ10 can interact with warfarin and some other medicines.

name: Cordyceps
description: A fungi-derived ingredient explored for endurance and antioxidant support.
ingredient_form: Cordyceps ingredient. Species, mycelium versus fruiting body, extraction ratio and marker content remain unconfirmed.
ingredient_source: Cordyceps-related fungi may be cultivated. The orange fruiting-body illustration is an association, not confirmation of species or sourcing.
ingredient_functions: Studied for exercise-related and fatigue-related outcomes. | Fungal polysaccharides and other compounds are investigated in laboratory research.
evidence_notes: Human evidence is limited and preparations differ. Laboratory results do not establish a benefit for this formula.
ingredient_considerations: Immunosuppressant, anticoagulant and glucose-lowering medicine use requires review.

name: Folic Acid
description: A form of folate, a vitamin involved in normal cell division and maternal folate status.
ingredient_form: Folic acid, as named in the reference catalog; this is not a confirmed methylfolate / 5-MTHF ingredient.
ingredient_source: Manufactured folic acid is used in supplements and fortified foods. Spinach is a natural folate food source, not the raw-material source claimed here.
ingredient_functions: Contributes to normal blood formation and cell division. | Adequate folate before and during early pregnancy is important for neural tube development.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. Pregnancy requirements need appropriate guidance; this builder is not a prenatal prescription.
ingredient_considerations: Large amounts of folic acid can mask signs of vitamin B12 deficiency.

name: Ginger Extract
description: A ginger-root extract traditionally used in digestive and everyday wellness routines.
ingredient_form: Ginger root / rhizome extract. Extraction ratio, solvent and gingerol standardisation are not yet specified.
ingredient_source: Zingiber officinale rhizome. Final grower, ingredient manufacturer and country of origin remain unconfirmed.
ingredient_functions: Has been investigated for nausea in specific settings. | Traditionally used in digestive-comfort routines.
evidence_notes: Evidence depends on the preparation and use. It does not establish a digestive benefit at this reference catalog amount.
ingredient_considerations: Concentrated ginger can cause digestive discomfort; discuss supplement use when taking medicines.

name: Ginseng
description: A traditional root ingredient, explored in the reference catalog for antioxidant and cognitive support.
ingredient_form: Ginseng ingredient. Species confirmation, powder versus extract, processing and ginsenoside content remain unspecified.
ingredient_source: Panax ginseng root is the plant shown and discussed here. White / red processing, cultivation source and supplier require confirmation.
ingredient_functions: Some studies have examined general fatigue and cognitive tasks. | Ginsenosides are among the compounds investigated in ginseng research.
evidence_notes: Human results are mixed. Ginseng has not consistently improved athletic performance.
ingredient_considerations: Insomnia and interactions with blood-thinning or glucose-lowering medicines are relevant considerations.

name: Inositol
description: A naturally occurring compound, listed in the reference catalog for metabolic and women’s wellness.
ingredient_form: Inositol. Myo-inositol, D-chiro-inositol or a specified ratio has not been identified in the current record.
ingredient_source: Found in foods and made by the body. The commercial production route and purity for VITA TAPE have not been selected.
ingredient_functions: Participates in cellular signalling pathways. | Myo-inositol and related preparations have been studied for metabolic and ovarian-function outcomes.
evidence_notes: Clinical findings depend on isomer, dose and population. They do not establish a benefit from an unspecified form or this concept.
ingredient_considerations: This card does not establish treatment for PCOS, infertility or diabetes.

name: Iodine
description: An essential mineral involved in normal thyroid hormone production and cognitive function.
ingredient_form: Iodine. Potassium iodide, iodate, kelp-derived material or another form has not been confirmed.
ingredient_source: Seaweed, seafood, dairy and iodised salt can supply dietary iodine. The kelp image does not mean this ingredient is a kelp extract.
ingredient_functions: Supports normal thyroid hormone production. | Contributes to normal energy metabolism and cognitive function.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. Both insufficient and excessive iodine can affect thyroid function.
ingredient_considerations: Thyroid disease and thyroid medicine use require individual advice before adding iodine.

name: K2 Vital Delta™
description: A branded vitamin K2 ingredient, explored for the maintenance of normal bones.
ingredient_form: The reference names K2VITAL™ DELTA: all-trans menaquinone-7 (MK-7) in a protected, double-microencapsulated preparation.
ingredient_source: A branded manufactured MK-7 ingredient from the K2VITAL range. Final grade and production route, including fermented versus other grades, are not confirmed for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_functions: Vitamin K contributes to normal blood clotting. | Vitamin K is involved in proteins important to normal bone metabolism.
evidence_notes: Established vitamin K roles. Specific cardiovascular or fracture-prevention outcomes cannot be inferred for this formula.
ingredient_considerations: Vitamin K can significantly affect warfarin therapy; intake changes require professional advice.

name: Lutemax 2020
description: A branded carotenoid ingredient, explored for general eye health and visual comfort.
ingredient_form: Lutemax 2020® marigold extract; the exact powder or oil grade and active carotenoid percentages are not specified here.
ingredient_source: Tagetes erecta marigold flowers are the botanical source described by the ingredient manufacturer.
ingredient_functions: Lutein and zeaxanthin are components of macular pigment in the eye. | Specific preparations have been studied for visual function and responses to light.
evidence_notes: Ingredient research does not prove improved vision or disease prevention from the final tape.
ingredient_considerations: Total extract mass and the individual amounts of lutein and zeaxanthin must be distinguished.

name: Lycopene
description: A carotenoid found in red plants, explored for antioxidant and cardiovascular wellness.
ingredient_form: Lycopene ingredient. Isomer profile, concentration and carrier are not specified for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_source: Tomatoes are a familiar food source, while commercial ingredients can have different production routes. No tomato-derived supply has been confirmed.
ingredient_functions: Acts as a carotenoid antioxidant in biological research. | Has been investigated for cardiovascular and other health-related outcomes.
evidence_notes: An antioxidant mechanism does not establish prevention or treatment of a disease.
ingredient_considerations: The tomato illustration is a food association, not a promise about the source or concentration of the final ingredient.

name: Maca Powder
description: A powdered root botanical listed in the reference catalog for energy and general wellness.
ingredient_form: Maca powder, as named in the reference catalog. Raw versus gelatinised processing and any extract concentration are unconfirmed.
ingredient_source: Lepidium meyenii root / hypocotyl. Final growing region, processing site and supplier are not specified.
ingredient_functions: Traditionally included in food and vitality routines. | Human studies have investigated sexual well-being and other outcomes.
evidence_notes: Human evidence is limited and does not establish increased energy, hormone balance or endurance from this formula.
ingredient_considerations: Powder and concentrated extract are different preparations; an extract-equivalent claim requires a specification.

name: Milk Thistle Extract
description: A plant extract listed in the reference catalog for liver and women’s wellness.
ingredient_form: Milk thistle extract. Silymarin percentage, extraction method and grade remain unconfirmed.
ingredient_source: Silybum marianum fruits, often called seeds, are the usual extract material. The flower image identifies the plant, not the extracted plant part.
ingredient_functions: Silymarin compounds are investigated for antioxidant activity. | Milk thistle has been studied in liver-related settings.
evidence_notes: Results for liver conditions are conflicting or insufficient. A detox or liver-treatment effect is not established.
ingredient_considerations: People allergic to related plants may react. This ingredient should not replace assessment of abnormal liver tests.

name: Greens Blend
description: The reference blend combines broccoli, spinach, kale, kiwi and spirulina. VITA TAPE’s blend composition is not yet finalized.
ingredient_form: Greens blend; individual powders, extracts, proportions and processing remain unspecified for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_source: The reference Nourished Greens blend lists broccoli, spinach, kale, kiwi and spirulina. The VITA TAPE illustration is generic and does not define its final recipe.
ingredient_functions: Can contribute plant compounds depending on the actual ingredients and amounts. | No specific vitamin, mineral or fibre content can be inferred from a blend name alone.
evidence_notes: A small blend amount is not nutritionally equivalent to a serving of vegetables, and benefits are not established for this concept.
ingredient_considerations: Final composition, allergen status and nutrient testing need to be confirmed.

name: Resveratrol
description: A plant polyphenol explored for antioxidant and cardiovascular wellness.
ingredient_form: Resveratrol ingredient. Trans-resveratrol percentage, extraction route and carrier remain unspecified.
ingredient_source: Grape skins and Japanese knotweed are known botanical sources. The grape illustration does not confirm grape-derived extraction.
ingredient_functions: Studied in cell-signalling and antioxidant pathways. | Human studies have explored metabolic and cardiovascular markers.
evidence_notes: Laboratory findings and changes in markers do not establish anti-ageing, weight-loss or disease-prevention benefits.
ingredient_considerations: Blood-thinning medicines and other drug interactions require review; final purity and source matter.

name: Scutell'Up
description: A branded botanical ingredient, listed in the reference catalog for calm, cognitive and sleep routines.
ingredient_form: SCUTELL’UP® Scutellaria baicalensis root extract powder. The supplier describes a grade containing at least 85% baicalin; VITA TAPE grade and assay are unconfirmed.
ingredient_source: Scutellaria baicalensis root, not American skullcap leaf. Manufacturer information identifies the reference botanical material.
ingredient_functions: Has been investigated in stress-related biological pathways. | Ingredient-specific research explores perceived calm and related outcomes.
evidence_notes: Much of the mechanism evidence is preliminary. Supplier claims do not establish treatment of anxiety or effects of this formula.
ingredient_considerations: Botanical identity, liver-safety considerations and medicine use need review before a final product specification.

name: Selenium
description: An essential mineral involved in normal immune function and antioxidant protection.
ingredient_form: Selenium. Selenomethionine, selenite, selenium yeast or another form has not been selected for VITA TAPE.
ingredient_source: Food sources include seafood, meat and some nuts. The mineral granule image is only conceptual; commercial source and form are unconfirmed.
ingredient_functions: Contributes to normal antioxidant defence through selenoproteins. | Supports normal thyroid and immune function.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. More selenium does not mean stronger antioxidant protection.
ingredient_considerations: Excess intake can be toxic; total intake across foods and supplements matters.

name: Silica
description: A silicon-containing ingredient explored in the reference catalog for connective tissue, hair and nails.
ingredient_form: Silica / silicon-containing ingredient. Silicon dioxide versus other forms and the active silicon content are unconfirmed.
ingredient_source: The reference product describes a bamboo-derived silica ingredient. Final VITA TAPE sourcing remains unconfirmed; the quartz illustration does not mean edible quartz is added.
ingredient_functions: Silicon has been investigated in connective-tissue biology. | Some specific preparations have been studied for hair, nails or skin-related outcomes.
evidence_notes: Evidence is limited and preparation-specific. No established beauty benefit can be inferred from this generic entry.
ingredient_considerations: Silica mass and elemental silicon content are different; source and chemical form need confirmation.

name: Tart Cherry
description: A cherry-derived botanical, explored in the reference catalog for recovery and sleep routines.
ingredient_form: Tart cherry ingredient. Powder versus extract, concentration and anthocyanin content remain unspecified.
ingredient_source: Prunus cerasus fruit. Final cultivar, processing method and ingredient supplier are not confirmed.
ingredient_functions: Some juice and concentrate preparations have been studied for exercise recovery. | Small studies have examined sleep-related outcomes.
evidence_notes: Findings for juice or standardised concentrates do not establish an effect from this ingredient mass or final formula.
ingredient_considerations: This is a cherry ingredient, not added melatonin; fruit imagery does not specify a melatonin quantity.

name: Vitamin A
description: An essential vitamin involved in the maintenance of normal vision and immune function.
ingredient_form: Vitamin A. Retinol / retinyl esters versus provitamin A carotenoids have not been identified in the current VITA TAPE record.
ingredient_source: Animal foods supply preformed vitamin A, while carrots and some other plants supply provitamin A carotenoids. The carrot image does not specify a beta-carotene formulation.
ingredient_functions: Contributes to normal vision and immune function. | Supports normal skin and cell differentiation.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. Preformed vitamin A and beta-carotene have different safety considerations.
ingredient_considerations: Excess preformed vitamin A is especially relevant during pregnancy. High-dose beta-carotene is unsuitable for some smokers.

name: Vitamin E
description: An essential vitamin involved in protection of cells from oxidative stress.
ingredient_form: Vitamin E. Natural / synthetic stereochemistry, tocopherol form and ester preparation are not specified.
ingredient_source: Vegetable oils, nuts and seeds are food sources. The almond image does not establish an almond-derived ingredient or its allergen status.
ingredient_functions: Helps protect cells from oxidative damage. | Contributes to normal immune function.
evidence_notes: Established nutrient roles. Antioxidant activity does not establish anti-ageing or cardiovascular-disease prevention.
ingredient_considerations: High supplemental intakes can increase bleeding-related concerns, especially with blood-thinning medicines.

name: White Kidney Bean Extract
description: A bean-derived botanical listed in the reference catalog for digestive and metabolic wellness.
ingredient_form: White kidney bean extract. Alpha-amylase inhibitory activity, extraction method and standardisation are not specified.
ingredient_source: Phaseolus vulgaris seeds. The supplier, country of origin and processing conditions are not yet confirmed.
ingredient_functions: Some standardised extracts can inhibit alpha-amylase, an enzyme involved in starch digestion. | Weight-management studies use particular extracts and dietary settings.
evidence_notes: Results cannot be generalised to an unspecified extract or this reference amount; it does not cancel carbohydrate intake.
ingredient_considerations: Bean allergy, digestive effects and glucose-lowering medicines are relevant considerations.
